title: Pelican Products Recalls Flashlights and Replacement Battery Packs Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The battery packs in the flashlights can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,800 flashlights and 150 replacement battery packs (in addition, about 800 flashlights and 18 replacement battery packs were sold in Canada).

title: Illume Recalls Valentine's Day-Themed Ceramic Mugs Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Target Stores
summary: The mugs were mislabeled as microwave safe. If microwaved, the metallic print on the mug can spark, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 12,300.

title: Ambient Weather Expands Recall of Radios Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The weather radio can overheat when plugged into an AC power outlet, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 57,000 (In addition, about 12,500 were recalled in August 2015).

title: United Pet Group Recalls Top Fin Power Filters for Aquariums Due to Shock Hazard; Sold Exclusively at PetSmart
summary: A conductor on the pump motor can become exposed and electrify the aquarium water, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 155,000 (in addition, about 3,300 filters were sold in Canada).

title: IKEA Recalls Floor and Table Lamps due to Shock Hazard
summary: Cables damaged during manufacturing can come in contact with the metal body of the lamp, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 30,600.

title: RacerMate Recalls CompuTrainer Blue Flywheels Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The blue flywheel can shatter while in use and throw metal pieces into the air. This poses a risk of injury from impact to the rider and any bystanders. Units: About 25,000.

title: GE Lighting Recalls High-Intensity LED Replacement Lamps Due to Impact Hazard
summary: The lamp can separate from its base and fall onto consumers below, posing an impact hazard. Units: About 35,000 (in addition, about 500 were sold in Mexico).

title: SRAM Recalls Zipp Bicycle Quick Releases Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
summary: The quick releases can fail to engage in the closed position, posing crash and injury hazards to the rider. Units: About 6,400.

title: SRAM Recalls Zipp Bicycle Wheel Hubs Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
summary: The hub flanges on the front hubs can fail, posing a crash and injury hazard. Units: About 54,000 (In addition, about 2,900 were sold in Canada).

title: Franklin Fueling Systems Recalls Gas Station Hose/Swivel Fitting Sets Due to Fire, Explosion Hazards
summary: The swivel fitting can separate from the hose, causing fuel to leak, posing a fire and explosion hazard. Units: About 9,000.

title: Room & Board Recalls Chairs Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Room & Board (Recall Alert)
summary: The backrest can break during normal use, posing a laceration hazard to the user. Units: About 1,500.

title: Anchor Industries Recalls Safety Pool Covers Due to Drowning Risk (Recall Alert)
summary: The brass-plated snap hooks used to connect the cover's cables to the wall can break, posing a drowning risk. Units: About 350.

title: Carlin Recalls Williamson and Thermoflo Furnaces and Boilers Equipped with Carlin Burners Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: A wiring malfunction can result in the burners failing to shut off, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 110.

title: KYMCO Recalls Utility Vehicles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The throttle can fail to return to idle causing the rider to lose control, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 1,700.

title: Z Gallerie Recalls Wall Clocks Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The batteries inside the clock can overheat due to defective battery springs located at the bottom of the battery compartment, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 450.

title: Liberty Hardware Recalls Decorative Metal Wall Plates Due to Shock and Fire Hazard
summary: The decorative wall plates can dislodge from the backplate and short circuit the outlet, posing a risk of electrical shock or fire. Units: About 374,000.

title: CE North America Expands Recall of Fan Heaters Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at H-E-B
summary: The fan heaters can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: 8,500 (in addition, about 28,000 were recalled in February 2016.).

title: Creating X Recalls Children's Pajamas Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard (Recall Alert)
summary: The pajamas fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 5,400.

title: Gamewell-FCI Recalls Fire Alarm Panels Due to Failure to Alert of a Fire, Smoke or CO
summary: When configured in a certain way, the panels can become non-responsive and connected detectors in the area can fail to detect and respond to an alarm. Units: About 1,000.

title: Grosfillex Recalls Commercial Side Chairs and Armless Bar Stools Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The backrest can crack and detach, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 92,000.

title: Manhattan Toy Recalls Table Top Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The round plastic beads can break, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 2,100 (in addition, 448 were sold in Canada).

title: Black Diamond Recalls Nylon Runners Due to Fall Hazard
summary: A nylon runner with a tape splice (two cut ends joined by masking tape) will fail in normal use, posing a risk of death or injury due to a fall. Units: About 185,000 (in addition, 23,600 were sold in Canada).

title: Black Diamond Recalls to Inspect Carabiners Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The carabiner can unexpectedly open and allow the rope to become detached, posing a risk of injury or death to climbers from a fall. Units: About 1.16 million (in addition, 81,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Toshiba Recalls Laptop Computer Battery Packs Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The lithium-ion battery packs can overheat, posing burn and fire hazards to consumers. Units: About 91,000 (in addition, 10,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Additional Injuries Prompt Reannouncement of Fiskars Recall of Bypass Lopper Shears Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Home Depot
summary: The lopper handles can break when attempting to cut branches, posing a risk of serious injury and laceration. Units: About 277,000 (in addition, 11,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Headlights and Taillights Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The headlights and taillights can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 110,000.

title: Panasonic Recalls Lithium-ion Laptop Battery Packs Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Conductive foreign material was mixed into the battery cells during manufacturing, posing a risk of fire. Units: About 387 (in addition, 110 were sold in Canada).
